note: GENERATION INPUT — not the artifact. This file names WHICH official administrations are in scope and where each one's evidence bundle lives. scripts/build-qualification-defaults.js reads it, pulls the matching rows verbatim out of a scorecard store, and derives references/official-qualification-defaults.json. Editing this file changes the selection; it can never change a row's contents. Every entry is cross-checked against its bundle's qualify-out.json (engine/runner/role/status/date/corpus_version/prompt_config_hash must all match the store row) and the build fails closed on any mismatch.
